Download meteorological and atmospheric data

Source: R/source-merra2.R
download_merra2.Rd

The download_merra2() function accesses and downloads various meteorological and atmospheric collections from NASA's Modern-Era Retrospective analysis for Research and Applications, Version 2 (MERRA-2) model, and the daily corrected Global Fire Weather Index (FWI) product derived from MERRA-2 weather inputs.

Usage

download_merra2(
  collection = c("inst1_2d_asm_Nx", "inst1_2d_int_Nx", "inst1_2d_lfo_Nx",
    "inst3_3d_asm_Np", "inst3_3d_aer_Nv", "inst3_3d_asm_Nv", "inst3_3d_chm_Nv",
    "inst3_3d_gas_Nv", "inst3_2d_gas_Nx", "inst6_3d_ana_Np", "inst6_3d_ana_Nv",
    "statD_2d_slv_Nx", "tavg1_2d_adg_Nx", "tavg1_2d_aer_Nx", "tavg1_2d_chm_Nx",
    "tavg1_2d_csp_Nx", "tavg1_2d_flx_Nx", "tavg1_2d_int_Nx", "tavg1_2d_lfo_Nx",
    "tavg1_2d_lnd_Nx", "tavg1_2d_ocn_Nx", "tavg1_2d_rad_Nx", "tavg1_2d_slv_Nx",
    "tavg3_3d_mst_Ne", "tavg3_3d_trb_Ne", "tavg3_3d_nav_Ne", "tavg3_3d_cld_Np", 
    
    "tavg3_3d_mst_Np", "tavg3_3d_rad_Np", "tavg3_3d_tdt_Np", "tavg3_3d_trb_Np",
    "tavg3_3d_udt_Np", "tavg3_3d_odt_Np", "tavg3_3d_qdt_Np", "tavg3_3d_asm_Nv",
    "tavg3_3d_cld_Nv", "tavg3_3d_mst_Nv", "tavg3_3d_rad_Nv", "tavg3_2d_glc_Nx", "fwi"),
  nasa_earth_data_token = NULL,
  date = c("2018-01-01", "2018-01-01"),
  directory_to_save = NULL,
  acknowledgement = FALSE,
  download = TRUE,
  remove_command = FALSE,
  hash = FALSE,
  show_progress = TRUE,
  max_tries = 20,
  rate_limit = 2
)

Arguments

collection

character vector. One or more supported MERRA-2 collection identifiers, or "fwi" for the daily corrected Global Fire Weather Index product (MERRA2.CORRECTED). Repeated identifiers are removed. The default selects all collections listed in the function signature, including FWI. Supported identifiers and product metadata are stored in the installed extdata/df_merra2.csv lookup table.

nasa_earth_data_token

character(1) or NULL. NASA Earthdata token, path to a file containing a token, or NULL to use the NASA_EARTHDATA_TOKEN environment variable. get_token() checks the environment variable first, then a supplied file path or token string. Token lookup is required when any standard MERRA-2 collection is requested.

date

character(1 or 2). A single day or two range endpoints in "YYYY-MM-DD" format. Endpoints may be supplied in either order; the resulting daily sequence includes both endpoints.

directory_to_save

character(1). Non-empty directory path for downloads. A path must be supplied despite the NULL default. Data files are saved under a subdirectory named for each collection; available XML companions are saved in that collection's metadata subdirectory.

acknowledgement

logical(1). Must be TRUE to proceed, acknowledging that the downloads may require substantial storage and memory.

download

logical(1). Deprecated. FALSE emits a warning and returns a download preview. Required token lookup, directory creation, and file discovery still run before returning. Standard collections require remote listing requests in preview mode; FWI URLs are constructed locally.

remove_command

logical(1). Deprecated and ignored. TRUE emits a warning.

hash

logical(1). If TRUE, return the combined MD5 hash calculated by download_hash() for all files under directory_to_save, including metadata and files from earlier downloads. Default is FALSE. Ignored when download = FALSE.

show_progress

logical(1). Show per-file progress messages and download progress bars. Default is TRUE; summary and status messages may still be printed when FALSE.

max_tries

integer(1). Maximum attempts per listing or file request, including the initial attempt. Must be at least 1. Default is 20.

rate_limit

numeric(1). Non-negative request-throttling interval in seconds. Default is 2. Passed to both discovery and file downloads; their throttling behavior is described below.

Value

With download = TRUE and hash = FALSE, an invisible list containing success, failed, and skipped file counts, plus failed_urls and failed_files character vectors. All five fields are always present; the two failure vectors are character(0) when no downloads failed, including when every file was skipped. Counts include XML metadata files.

With download = TRUE and hash = TRUE, a character scalar containing the combined directory MD5 hash, returned visibly.

With download = FALSE, an invisible preview list containing urls, destfiles, and n_files, regardless of hash.

Details

Standard MERRA-2 file URLs are discovered from monthly HTML directory listings. Published stream and revision prefixes are retained, and all matching files are included when more than one revision is listed for a date. Every requested date must have at least one matching .nc4 file in its directory. Companion .nc4.xml metadata is optional and is included only when the corresponding data file is also listed. FWI .nc URLs are constructed directly from the requested dates.

Discovery stops before file downloads if a monthly listing cannot be read, a requested data date is missing, or different URLs in a listing would use the same local filename. Once discovery succeeds, download_run_method() skips existing non-empty files and records individual download failures, warning after the remaining files have been attempted.

Listing requests to the same host are spaced by at least rate_limit seconds; 0 disables listing throttling. File downloads use the host-based token bucket described in download_run_method(). Discovery and file downloads use their default per-attempt timeout of 3600 seconds; this function does not expose a timeout argument.

Note

Due to NASA data access policies, standard MERRA-2 GES DISC downloads require a valid NASA Earthdata token for authentication. Use setup_nasa_token() for setup. The "fwi" collection is hosted on the public GlobalFWI portal and does not require Earthdata authentication.

See also

setup_nasa_token(), get_token(), download_run_method(), download_hash(), process_merra2(), get_merra2_info()

Author

Mitchell Manware, Insang Song, Kyle Messier

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Configure NASA_EARTHDATA_TOKEN with setup_nasa_token() before downloading.
download_merra2(
  collection = "inst1_2d_int_Nx",
  date = "2024-01-01",
  directory_to_save = tempdir(),
  acknowledgement = TRUE
)

# Download two collections for an inclusive date range.
download_merra2(
  collection = c("inst1_2d_int_Nx", "tavg1_2d_slv_Nx"),
  date = c("2024-01-01", "2024-01-02"),
  directory_to_save = file.path(tempdir(), "merra2"),
  acknowledgement = TRUE,
  max_tries = 3
)
} # }
